Definition: from G1384; to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve:--allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try.
BiblicalUsage: To test, to prove, the assaying of metal, applied to faith, teaching, and the will of God. Paul tells us to prove what is the good and acceptable will of God, and to prove all things and hold fast to what is good. John warns not to believe every spirit but to test them, and Peter says the trial of faith is more precious than gold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God tests what He loves, and the testing is how I learn what is real. Faith that has been tried is not weaker for the fire; it is proved, like gold, and the praise of it belongs to God.
